newsitem.title: USA: Belo to take controlling interest in paper.
newsitem.headline: Belo to take controlling interest in paper.

text.p: A.H. Belo Corp said Friday it agreed to buy a controlling interest in the Press-Enterprise, a privately-held newspaper serving Riverside county and inland Southern California.
Company spokesmen were not immediately available to comment on the terms of the deal or its expected closing date.
Belo currently holds a 38.45 percent interest in the 162,000 circulation newspaper, a statement said. Belo said it bought the stake in June, 1996.
The publishing company is obtaining the stake from Howard Hays and his brothers, Daniel Hays of Riverside, Calif., and William Hays of Denver, the statement said.
